spec_notes: Final primary stories describe actual 14-inch MacBook Pro with base M5 and actual 15-inch MacBook Air with M4. Their photos and specifications match.
All technical specifications and launch dates checked on 2026-11-09 against official Apple sources. Announcement and customer-availability dates are separate.
Physical sizes converted from Apple centimeters to millimeters. Battery runtime is an Apple up-to test result; actual runtime varies.
Display diagonals are rectangular measurements; actual viewable area is reduced by rounded corners.
No current price claims are derived from prices visible in older retail photographs.
M6 and M5 Air specifications removed from the final technical_specs array to prevent mixing generations.

research.prioritized_source: Wikimedia Commons actual file pages and imageinfo API; Apple Support for specifications.
method: Web searches for exact model and license terms.
Commons API file-namespace search with quoted MacBook and M6 or M5, and title searches.
Actual candidate file pages inspected for model, photographer, source and image license.
Original files downloaded and byte count plus SHA-1 verified against Commons.
Delivered M5 Pro14 and M4 Air15 originals visually inspected; visible retail-screen model labels independently corroborate each chip generation and display-size class.

limits: Bounded search found no verified license-clear M6 photo; the entire Pro story now uses actual M5 per user decision.
The M5 Air13 camera photograph was excluded because its source discloses generative cleanup without describing the edit extent.
For delivered CC0 originals, no generative edits are disclosed on source pages; original bytes are retained.

ui_contract.model_policy: Use actual MacBook Pro with base M5 and MacBook Air with M4 names and matching specifications throughout. The Pro uses base M5, not an M5 Pro chip. No M6 story with an M5 photo. No AI-cleaned M5 Air13 photo. Exactly two selected Mac products.
